mechanism.en: Where target carriers each leave at least a offspring and other parents at most b < a, both kinds present, the carriers' offspring stand to the others' strictly more than the carriers to the others, read as shares where offspring carry the target (a premise). Where the next configuration depends on the rule, not the state, a perturbed state is re-absorbed in one step.

open.en: Re-absorption is shown only where the next configuration does not depend on the state, a strong condition; where winners rewrite the rule, making it depend on the state, the law says nothing of whether the outcome is held.
It derives neither that taking more yields more offspring, nor that offspring carry their parents' target, nor that winners shape the rule.

mechanism.en: On a two-level course, let selection not lower a target's share under a rule favouring it (Raises) and the rule read at each reading step be a monotone function of the share (ReadsShare); with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. Locked, neither share nor rule falls, and a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.

edge.en: A perturbation reversing the rule's direction, held past the threshold, is not absorbed: from the step after it neither share nor rule rises, and the rule after the first reading step is below the one before (a witness, under a threshold reading).

condition.en: Where the reading favours at every share, every course, whatever its start, is locked from the step after its second reading step; the bound is exact (from one to one under lo, the course is not locked at the step after its first reading step).

open.en: That any actual rule reads the share it selects, or reads it monotonically: this is the premise ReadsShare, where "the winner shapes the rule" of Becoming.Capture enters.
Real-valued shares and rates, rules that read more than the share, many levels, or noisy readings.
Left by drift, as a reading not stated as instances: a favouring rule read from the share that leaves the disfavoured kind a positive weight at every mixed count.

name.en: Closed capture (meta-attractor, in the glossary's sense)

mechanism.en: A loop of selection whose rule and whose reading of the rule are both formed from the share it selects, nothing in it reading what lies beyond the share. Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond (Unread), courses alike in share and rule stay alike, exactly then along every schedule, and from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked and neither share nor rule falls below the start. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

forbids.en: such a metric dropped by its selectors on evidence alone; such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case; a reform of the reading alone outlasting the next reading; a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

edge.en: Read what lies beyond the share: a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks the course after every reading step past it; where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of it of any size is absorbed.
Read in the grammar: along a two-level step whose reading favours at no loss past a bound, with a reading step past the bound, the line under favouring or not from a favouring start is not unending.

condition.en: Where the rule read favours at every reading and every share, every course is locked from the step after its second reading step, whatever rule and reading it starts with.

open.en: That any actual rule, or how it is read, is formed from the share it selects: this is the premise ReadsShare, on the rule and on mind.
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58).
Real-valued shares, noisy or partial readings, readings that read both the share and part of what lies beyond, and the calibration of any of this to the present world.
Selection of selection as a law relating two grains: here the two levels are one law on one joint carrier, read at one grain.
A reading of the loss is one sufficient way out, not shown the only one.
Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

beyond.en: Where every step adds at least one to what lies beyond (Accrues), from a locked configuration the loss at step t is at least t above where it started, so it passes every bound, while the course stays locked. That what lies beyond the share is a loss to any formation is a significance's to say; here it is a count the loop does not read.

mechanism.en: Read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings, each carrier among the readers reading it as u and each other as v, the readers counted as the population counts them; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where v is not above u. Against a mirrored reading the counts decide, and where only the others read the loss, once it reaches a bound, the counts when they read it decide for good whether the lock is kept or turned. The premise is moved to who reads, not removed.

forbids.en: a metric whose loss is read only by those it disfavours, dropped once the selection has left them no more than its carriers among its readers, with nothing else changed, more often than drift alone would allow.

edge.en: The loss read by the others: with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', and the rule in force favouring the carriers, the lock is kept for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read; read from the start, the same readers reading the same loss lock the course the other way (witness).

condition.en: Against a mirrored reading, the carriers' reading favouring them strictly, the pool favours the carriers exactly where they are at least as many as the others, and the others exactly where they are at least as many as the carriers.

With the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', at a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers, the course is locked for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others there; the rule in force favouring the others, it is locked the other way for good exactly where the others are at least as many.

open.en: That any actual rule is the pool of readers drawn from those it selects, or that each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind: within the pool ReadsShare is equivalent to that comparison, so the premise is moved to who reads, not removed.

Readers of one kind reading differently, weights other than counts, readings formed by argument; the pool sums readings unnormalized, so a reading's size weighs with its count (mirrored readings have equal sizes).
That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58, D67). Nor the calibration of any of this to the present world.

beyond.en: Read late, both favouring the carriers, the lock holds while the loss grows and every other reader reads it.

name.en: The capacity to shape the rule, selected by what comes back to it

mechanism.en: Where a selection's carriers shape the rule that selects them, the rule favours them at a step exactly where what comes back to them alone covers its cost, whatever comes to every member alike; across a stretch the counts of steps before and with what comes back decide, and the shared part, being part of the base, can turn the verdict. Listed in groups of m whose shapers give the group's shared part, the condition is Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added, exactly where c < s + m q ρ. Where the rule is read monotonically from the share and covers the cost, the loop locks.

edge.en: Shaping that brings nothing back to the shapers alone: with a positive cost and the shapers present, their share falls at every step; where something does come back, the shared part can turn a stretch, and cheaper shaping raises the selection for control.

condition.en: At a step the rule favours the shapers (weakly) exactly where c ≤ s and disfavours them (weakly) exactly where s ≤ c, whatever p comes to every member alike.

Across m steps before anything comes back and n steps with it, the shapers present, their share does not fall exactly where (a + c + p)^m (a + c + p)^n ≤ (a + p)^m (a + s + p)^n, and rises strictly exactly where the inequality is strict.

At a threshold, what comes back hi where the shapers are at least as many as the others and lo where they are fewer, with lo < c < hi, from above the share rises strictly at every step and from below it falls strictly at every step, the shapers present; under every schedule of reading.

The whole selects for shaping exactly where c times the spread of shaping falls short of s times it with m q times the spread among groups: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ, exactly where c < s + m q ρ.

open.en: That actual practices, institutions or trained systems carry a capacity to shape their rule from parent to offspring, or that what comes back to them is read from their share: these are premises, and their calibration to the present world is not established.
Graded capacities, returns growing with the domains captured or passing between them, real-valued shares.
How groups form, and assortment changing over generations or with the share: they enter as given at the step.
Graded capacities to shape the rule, groups that form or assort by the share, a gain growing with the number of domains captured, gains passing between domains.

name.en: The critical mass: what comes back to the shapers, read by readers drawn from the selected

mechanism.en: Read the rule after shaping as the pool of its readers, drawn from those it selects, each shaper among them reading hi coming back to the shapers alone and each other member lo; the rule read reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and then a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi. From a start under the rule read there, above that critical mass the capacity to shape the rule rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it the capacity falls at every step and the course is locked the other way, without noise. Drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the critical mass.

forbids.en: such a metric, its selectors many and its share far above the critical mass, left with nothing read changed more often than the drawn model's bound across that distance allows, its premises (one member drawn at a time, constant readings and cost) read on the case

edge.en: Read the loss in time: with lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, the loss growing by one a step, from a start favouring the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good exactly where the late reading still favours the others at the share a step on; once it would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, at most one step lies between, and a deadline bounds the window.

Drift: drawn one member at a time, from every mixed count the histories losing every shaper weigh at least down^i times every later history, above the critical mass too, and those fixing them at least a^k within reach of the top, below it too; no new reader and no change in what is read.

condition.en: With lo ≤ hi, the rule read favours the shapers at some share and the others strictly at another exactly where lo < c < hi; with lo ≤ c ≤ hi, it favours the shapers exactly where x.other · (c − lo) ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).
With no hypothesis on the readers, the rule read favours the shapers at every share exactly where c ≤ lo and c ≤ hi, and the others strictly at every share exactly where lo < c and hi ≤ c.

Where the rule read at s favours the shapers, from s + n with t to the top, losing every shaper weighs, times the shapers' weights over s + 1 … s + n, at most t times down^n times the whole weight; below the mass, fixing them from j + 1 is bounded the other way.

At an even population the rule read favours the shapers strictly exactly where 2c < hi + lo, risk dominance in counts; which state one member arising fixes more often is a product of weights that can part from it.

open.en: That control over the selection left unselected and a lock left in time are independent conditions: in this model, whose rule is read from the share alone, every course from the rule read at its start is locked one way or the other (drawn_locked_either), so control not selected does not by itself give a lock left in time, and the converse cannot be shown here; leaving needs a reading beyond the share (ClosedCapture.Thinned), joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others (MA4b).

Readers who learn (hi and lo changing with the share), a cost changing with the share, readers not counted as the population counts them, starts not under the rule read there (a rule in force against the reading can carry the share across the mass, RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed), a loss read by part of the readers once the shapers pass the mass (ClosedCapture.Thinned, joined in loss-read-in-time-by-the-others, MA4b), and the mixed point where lo > hi and hi < c ≤ lo.

The long-run state under rare mutation, the one with the larger fixation weight (Fudenberg and Imhof 2006), which is cited; mutation and a time to leave a lock beyond the geometric bound are not stated.
That risk dominance decides which state one member arising fixes more often: the two can part under strong selection.

name.en: The loss read in time by the others, joined to the critical mass

mechanism.en: Let a loss grow by one a step, and let the others among the readers drawn from the selected read it once it reaches a bound, reading lo' for lo, while the shapers keep reading hi. From a start under the rule read there that favours the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading still favours the others, ties included, at the share a step on; once that reading would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, and at most one step lies between. Whether a reading is in time is decided by the share at the step read and the next; the loss only sets the step from which it is read.

edge.en: Where every step adds at least one to the loss and lo' ≤ hi, at a reading step at which the loss has reached N and the late reading favours the others at the share there (ties included), the next step reading too, the course is locked the other way for good from two steps after the reading exactly where the late reading favours the others at the share of the next step; it can do so where control is selected (Window.in_time, a witness).

condition.en: From a start the rule read there favours, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, read from a reading step N, the course is locked for good from N + 1 exactly where the late reading favours the shapers at the share of step N, and, step N + 1 reading too, the other way from N + 2 exactly where it favours the others (ties included) at the share of step N + 1; at most one step has the late reading favouring the others strictly at its share and the shapers strictly at the next.

From a start with a shaper present whose rule g read there favours the shapers strictly, lo ≤ hi and lo' ≤ hi, so that c < hi, the others reading the loss from any reading step N with g.other · c · x.other ≤ N leave the course locked in the shapers' favour at every step from N + 1, under every schedule of reading steps.
Where the late reading with nothing read as coming back (lo' = 0) favours the shapers, every late reading of this form does; with c ≤ hi that is exactly where x.other · c ≤ x.carrier · (hi − c).

open.en: A late reading of another form: with its own weight it has another window, and with a weight against the shapers chosen after the share is seen, far enough below theirs, the others could turn the course from any share.

The step from which the window is closed: the deadline is a bound, quadratic in the start's counts (24 in the witness and 96 from two to two, both closed from step 4); none is stated for a weakly favouring start or one with no shaper.

Courses with noise, readers who learn, readings changing with the share, a loss read before it reaches N, and a general law for the round from the one step between, which goes either way in the witnesses.

That leaving control unselected and leaving a lock in time are independent: control left unselected with a lock left in time is not shown, since with two kinds leaving the lock below the critical mass means a rule favouring the shapers.
That a trained judge reads as such a pool: the one frozen test of the timing law on one (LA2, experiments/self-rewarding-lock) found one note in nine turned it, so the law did not apply there.

name.en: A chooser's rule read from the count of its choices

mechanism.en: On RuleCapture's counts let a chooser over two policies take the first where its rule weighs it at least as much as the second, that policy's count rising by one, the rule read from the counts weighted by a standing score. Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves, also where the score favours the second policy. Joined to a coordinate the loop does not read and that rises at every step, the locked course outlives every bound on it.

edge.en: A moved count: three choices to one keep the first policy against a score weighing the second twice as much; one count moved, three to two, locks the other way (witness).
A change of score: to one to four, read at once, it locks the other way, while read one step late, the old rule still in force, it leaves the first policy locked (witness).

condition.en: Under a standing score, with the rule in force read from the counts at the start, along every schedule of reading the threshold κo · other ≤ κc · carrier divides the counts into two regions the course never leaves: at or above it the chooser takes the first policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule falls; below it the chooser takes the second policy at every step and neither the share nor the rule rises. Ties go to the first policy.

open.en: That actual agents, brains or trained systems count their choices so or choose at the argmax; the overtraining effect the lock matches in rats has failed to replicate in humans (de Wit and others 2018).
More than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, additive counting's timescale, and that a crossing under posterior counting comes within any horizon.

For a rule read from the count of its choices: more than two policies, intermediate precision, a score that changes with the outcomes, the split among policies that explain a trial equally, a law with a bound for additive counting, and a frozen test of whether a count of choices reverses under a standing score (§9).

beyond.en: Joined to a coordinate that neither the counts nor the score reads, rising by at least one at every step, from counts at or above the threshold with the rule in force read from them the coordinate stands at least b + t at step t while the course stays locked; a part acting only beyond the coupling closure does not change the choice.

name.en: Self-reproducing selection across carriers (the corpus's meta-attractor)

mechanism.en: The corpus's meta-attractor is wider than 元吸引子: an organization whose consequences take part in rebuilding the conditions that select it, continuing across changes of its carriers. Continuation across carriers is the map's 传; the formal 元吸引子 says nothing of carriers.

open.en: Whether a capture loop (§9) is 生成 at some pair of classes.

name.en: Capture reaching the routes of 明 (the second order)

mechanism.en: A second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves.

name.en: Rewarding those who break the routes of correction (the third order)

mechanism.en: A third order, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in, enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows.

beyond.en: enlarging the gap between reach and what couples in as capability grows

extract:C.notes:
Read-only work in /Users/ren/theories/.claude/worktrees/gc-reading-correction. Built and checked with scripts; the working copy is /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ren-theories/99fa549c-d982-4a21-9c77-afab7aa9b7b2/scratchpad/c-entries.json (builder build.py beside it). A script checked: every record exists and is recorded-checked (none superseded); every declaration is in its records' laws or counterexamples; every hypothesis index exists; every exit "to" resolves; every source anchor exists (explicit ids, plus GitHub slugs for COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION headings, the style other pages already use for #3-...); every test folder exists. Each open item is a verbatim copy except three, cut at a semicolon or with a link dropped: capture-through-the-rule's drift line (02 #which-locks-noise-leaves) and the two shaping lines (record DNS 3; 02 Open). Not checked against the core receipt: that the declarations are in it (they are copied from the records). Nothing was run beyond grep, sed and python reads.

Result: 11 entries (8 with records, 3 with no record). Row by row, C1–C16:
- C1 target-capture: kept. 02 §9 opens with it, but its rule is not read from the share. The record says that where winners rewrite the rule, the law says nothing. So it is filed as the family's first step, not a capture of the rule. MOVED OUT: its World laws on descent (Flow.descent_exhausted, descent_needs_unrun) are ending laws and belong in family A.
- C2 capture-through-the-rule: kept. MERGED in: C3 two-rules-lock-together (pair_locks is favouring_locks for a pair of rules, the same lock) and C13 (07 §6's D68 reading of a counter-rule, which applies uniform_locks, locked_stays, Reversed.not_absorbed and Alternating.never_locked; cited as a source, not a dynamic of its own). Reversed.not_absorbed is its exit (a witness, so sufficient). The exact uniform_locks bound (Second.second_exact) is filed as a pace bound. MOVED OUT: Alternating.never_locked stays in F (F4, the same record). Exit by drift for this rule is only a reading in 02 #which-locks-noise-leaves, so it is under open, not exits.
- C4 closed-capture = 元吸引子: kept, with the glossary's zh. MERGED in: C12 rules-that-change-themselves-in-the-grammar (lock_line, constant_iff_unread and loss_ends_line restate the closed lock on the root; its record says "This is capture through the rule"). Base stays "any type"; the root reading comes through that record. Its forbids is copied from T7's Forbids (02 #t7). T7 is a thesis: that actual metrics are so formed is conjectured, and the renderer should say so. The clause on drift and the clause on readers are also copied onto the critical-mass entry and the readers entry.
- C5 readers-drawn-from-the-selected: kept, a separate model (the pool and Thinned). Its kept_iff exit and window are on counts with the mirror premise.
- C6 shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back: kept. MERGED in: C7 shaping-selected-among-groups (the same selection of the capacity to shape; c < s + m q ρ is filed as a transition).
- C8 shaping-read-by-readers-drawn-from-the-selected: kept. MERGED in: C9 drawn-shaping-drawn-one-at-a-time (the same loop drawn one member at a time). It enters as the exit by drift (lost_ge), a transition of kind exit by drift (lost_above, fixed_below) and the risk-dominance condition (2c < hi + lo).
- C10 loss-read-in-time-by-the-others: kept as its own entry, because its model has three readings and its own window and deadline laws. C8's "Read the loss in time" exit (CD §2) points to it with turned_early_iff. Its own exit is turned_iff, the form from any reading step.
- C11 capture-by-counted-choices: kept. Base "any type" for the count laws. The record's label is "World for the selection laws; counts for the count laws", and the central capture laws are the count laws.
- C14 a-cascade-at-the-histories-reached: MOVED to family D (locks of knowing), beside readers-reading-readers in 05 §8. No rule is read from a share it selects: the acts carry only what couples into the members before k.
- C15 a-pool-that-recruits-through-itself: MOVED to family D. It is about membership formed through what a pool couples into, and it never couples a loss apart unless its course without the loss would. CD §2 lists it as the edge of the "Pool couplings" exit, and the plan's item PR would compose it with readers drawn from the selected. If PR lands, it may come back to C.
- C16 a-code-formed-between-formations: MOVED to family A. Agreement is a rest under every rule, and an imposed code stays, which is absorption. Its merged-distinctions laws are already G5 from the same record.

ADDED:
- self-reproducing-selection-across-carriers: the corpus's wide sense, per plan §3.3, standing "open". Sources are 02 #capture (the D65 reading) and #open. Records [] and base null; none of 08 §2's seven bases fits a dynamic with no model.
- capture-reaching-the-routes-of-correction and selection-for-narrowing-what-couples-in: the second and third orders in 02 §9's D26 reading, standing "reading", base null. They have no law, so they could also be open-item entries.

NOT ADDED:
- a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet (02 §9): the case where the lock's rise does not form, and its record does not show that the course leaves a lock. It is cited as a source of capture-through-the-rule, not filed as a dynamic or an exit.
- "accountable revision" (07 §6): a definition, and 07 says the models do not tell it from capture.

Labels and conventions:
- Base: 02 labels the shaping, critical-mass, drawn, read-in-time and counted laws "(counts)". 08 §2's seven bases have no "counts"; 08's opening puts counts under "any type", so they are filed "any type". Appendix A's base "C" is therefore not one of the seven.
- Sources: does-not-show items cite the generated record page anchor theories/becoming/results/records/<id>.md#does-not-show--未表明.
- Tests: LA2 (experiments/self-rewarding-lock, T7, run) is tied to closed-capture, readers-drawn-from-the-selected and loss-read-in-time-by-the-others; the home and the LA2 README name closed capture, MA2 and the timing law. LA3 (experiments/shaping-what-comes-back, thesis null, run) is tied to shaping. No test is tied to counted choices or the critical mass; 02 Open lists a frozen test for counted choices as open.
- Strength: "exact" is used only where the law is an iff (Thinned.kept_iff, ReadInTime.turned_early_iff, turned_iff). Witnesses and sufficient laws are "sufficient".

Corrections to Appendix A:
- Short names, fully qualified: C1 share_rises is Becoming.share_rises; C4 turned_by_loss is Becoming.ClosedCapture.turned_by_loss; C9 risk_dominant_iff is Becoming.DrawnReplacement.risk_dominant_iff; C10 deadline is Becoming.ReadInTime.deadline.
- Misattributed: C6's base "C" is "any type" as above. C8's drawn_locked_either is Becoming.DrawnShaping.drawn_locked_either. C13 is not a separate row.

check:C.summary:
Read-only check of the 11 family-C entries against the records' JSON, 02-MAP §9 (including T7, "which locks noise leaves" and the Open list), 07 §6, COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION §2–3, 08 §2 and the experiments README. Nothing was run beyond grep, sed and python3 reads.

What passed for every entry: every record exists with status recorded-checked, and none is superseded. Every declaration resolves to a theorem or def in the Lean sources. Every hypotheses index points at an existing hypothesis that the cited laws use. Every 02-MAP, 07 and record-page anchor exists as an explicit id. Valence is "none asserted" throughout, and nothing is marked good or bad. The tests ties hold: LA2 (self-rewarding-lock) for T7, closed capture, readers drawn from the selected and read in time; LA3 (shaping-what-comes-back) for shaping, from 07 §6.

Errors found, which change verdicts:
(1) Base. The 02 homes label shaping, its group form, the critical mass, its drawn form, read-in-time and the count laws of counted choices "(counts)". The entries say "any type". "counts" is not one of 08 §2's seven labels; the closest is "a named model" (RuleCapture's counts). The plan's Appendix A key uses "C counts", so the plan needs a stated mapping.
(2) Mechanisms drop qualifiers the home states:
- capture-through-the-rule: the condition under which "only a change of the law... leaves", and "That actual rules read the share is the premise".
- closed-capture: the premises of lock_outlives_loss (Accrues, Raises, ReadsShare, favouring kept upward), so the lock outliving the loss reads as if Unread alone gave it.
- readers-drawn-from-the-selected: the mirrored late reading and the rule in force.
- shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back: "read over the rationals where shaping varies", "(weakly)", and the transmission premise.
- shaping-read-by-readers-drawn-from-the-selected: "with shapers present", "under every schedule", and that these are premises.
- loss-read-in-time-by-the-others: "with lo' ≤ hi" and "start at zero".
(3) A transition cites the wrong law. In the shaping entry, Becoming.RuleShaping.grouped_rises_iff_sized (the any-size covariance law) is listed for the equal-groups ρ condition; that condition is grouped_rises_iff alone.
(4) Witnesses are labelled "sufficient":
- RuleCapture.Reversed.not_absorbed, which is also in the record's counterexamples, not its laws.
- ChoiceCountCapture.Witness.moved_locks_down.
- ChoiceCountCapture.Witness.Stale.devalued_read_at_once_locks_down.
A single constructed example is not a general sufficient condition, and the schema has no value for a witness; the plan should add one or move these out of exits.
(5) Two "beyond" fields use laws that are not in their declarations:
- readers drawn: Thinned.read_late_kept.
- counted choices: unchosen_beyond_coupling; its clause also drops "under the hypotheses of the blindness law".

Anchors: COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md has no id anchors at all. "#2-exits-each-under-stated-conditions" exists only as a heading slug, the same form the repo already uses for its §3. It fails the id= grep, so the renderer's anchor check must accept heading slugs or the page needs an id.

Structure:
- Merges against Appendix A: C3 into C2, C12 into C4 (C12's laws are root, not any type), C7 into C6 and C9 into C8.
- Not covered by any entry: C13 (the D68 counter-rule reading), C14 (information cascade), C15 (a pool recruiting through itself) and C16 (a shared code).
- The capture-through-the-rule entry cites #r-a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet without listing that record.
- The "second order" name clashes with the D45 reading's own "the corpus's second order" (control over the selection).

Verdicts: 4 entries ok (target-capture, self-reproducing-selection-across-carriers and both second- and third-order readings); 7 not ok, each with corrected fields. Each corrected object holds only the fields to replace.

mechanism.en: On a two-level course, let selection not lower a target's share under a rule favouring it (Raises) and the rule read at each reading step be a monotone function of the share (ReadsShare); with the start's rule and every rule read favouring, the share falls at no step and the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. Locked, neither share nor rule falls, and a perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; where the reading favours at every share every course locks from its second reading step, so only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves. That actual rules read the share is the premise; the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.

mechanism.en: A loop of selection whose rule, and how the rule is read, are read from the share it selects. Where neither the next share nor the rule read reads what lies beyond the share (Unread), courses alike in share and rule stay alike, exactly then along every schedule; where each step adds at least one beyond, selection does not lower the share under a favouring rule, the rule is read monotonically from the share and favouring is kept upward, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked and neither share nor rule falls below the start. Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.

mechanism.en: Read the rule as the pool of its readers' readings, each carrier among the readers reading it as u and each other as v, the readers counted as the population counts them; the rule read is then a monotone function of the share exactly where v is not above u. Against a mirrored reading the counts decide; where only the others read the loss, once it reaches a bound, with their late reading the mirror of the carriers', the lock is kept for good, the rule in force favouring the carriers, exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others when the loss is read, and turned for good, the rule in force favouring the others, exactly where the others are at least as many. The premise is moved to who reads, not removed: that actual rules are pools of readers so drawn, each kind reading at least as favourably for its own kind, is not shown.

(2) The mechanism, copied from 07 §6 rather than the 02 home, drops 'read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ the share of the spread among groups'. That is the condition under which c < s + m q ρ holds; grouped_alike_iff and the ρ form need shaping to vary. It also drops '(weakly)' and the 02 home's standing: 'That offspring carry their parent's capacity, and that what comes back is read from the share, are premises; ... the courses are without noise'.
(3) The fourth transition's condition is the equal-groups ρ law (grouped_rises_iff), but its declarations add Becoming.RuleShaping.grouped_rises_iff_sized. That is the any-size covariance law, a different condition. Either drop it or give it its own transition with its own condition: 'in groups of any sizes ... exactly where, read over the rationals, c times the variance of shaping falls short of s times it with q times the covariance...'.
(4) The COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION anchor is a heading slug only.

mechanism.en: Where a selection's carriers shape the rule that selects them, the rule favours them (weakly) at a step exactly where what comes back to them alone covers its cost, whatever comes to every member alike; across a stretch the counts of steps before and with what comes back decide, and the shared part, being part of the base, can turn the verdict. Listed in groups of m whose shapers give the group's shared part, the condition is Hamilton's rule with what comes back alone added: read over the rationals where shaping varies, with the assortment ρ the share of the spread among groups, exactly where c < s + m q ρ. Where the rule is read monotonically from the share and covers the cost, the loop locks; that offspring carry their parent's capacity, and that what comes back is read from the share, are premises, and the courses are without noise.

mechanism.en: Read the rule after shaping as the pool of its readers, drawn from those it selects, each shaper among them reading hi coming back to the shapers alone and each other member lo; the rule read reads the share monotonically exactly where lo ≤ hi, and then a share decides the direction exactly where lo < c < hi. From a start under the rule read there, with shapers present, under every schedule of reading, above that critical mass the capacity to shape the rule rises at every step and the course is locked for it, below it the capacity falls at every step and the course is locked the other way, without noise; that the readers are so drawn and read with lo ≤ hi, and that offspring carry the capacity, are premises. Drawn one member at a time, either lock is left by drift, at a weight whose bound shrinks across the distance from the critical mass.

mechanism.en: Let a loss start at zero and grow by one a step, and let the others among the readers drawn from the selected read it once it reaches a bound, from then on reading lo' for lo, with lo' ≤ hi, while the shapers keep reading hi. From a start under the rule read there that favours the shapers, a reading, the next step reading too, turns the course for good from two steps on exactly where the late reading still favours the others, ties included, at the share a step on; once that reading would favour the shapers every later reading keeps the lock, and at most one step lies between, from which a new round can go either way. Whether a reading is in time is decided by the share at the step read and the next; the loss only sets the step from which it is read.
